lede: The school board votes Monday on a flood-related budget appropriation for FY 2026-27 — real money moving because the canyon flooded the TIS 5th grade pod, the high school cafeteria, and the Palm Theatre complex this summer. While that's the sharpest item on the calendar, the Ethics Commission takes up a formal Code of Conduct recommendation for Town officials on Tuesday, and the Hospital District board weighs a possible Two Site Model decision for the new medical facility on Wednesday.

notable.stake: Board votes on flood-damage budget appropriation for FY 2026-27.
Commission recommends whether Town officials get a binding Code of Conduct.
Board may act on Two Site Model, shaping what and where new hospital gets built.
County weighs CCAP childcare funding and its budget implications for residents.
TMVOA votes on workforce housing committee formation and updated policies.
